result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is now a second name for `updateLandscape`, and both names run the same code path. The `cli` module compiles and its tests pass offline. I did not run the CLI itself, because the environment asked for approval to launch `java`. The help output and dispatch are checked by reading the code only.

Changes:

- **`cli/.../Commands.java`**: added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description, which says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. The no-argument usage overview now lists `analyzeLandscape` next to `updateLandscape`, both with the landscape options.
- **`cli/.../CommandLineInterface.java`**: `analyzeLandscape` dispatches to a new private `landscape(args, name, description)` method. `updateLandscape` calls the same method with its own name and description, so `-help` prints the command the user typed. Options, `-analysisRoot`, `-recursive`, `-confFile`, metadata, `-date` and `-timeout` are unchanged.
- **`README.md`**: the README had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Commands" section covering both names. Say if you would rather have it elsewhere.

I left `CLAUDE.md`, which still lists only `updateLandscape` among the main commands. Nothing is committed.
